_doc: Declarative Hevy routine config for the Comeback Protokoll (folder 3019499). hevy_routine_sync.py uses this to (a) patch rest_seconds on existing routines via GET->patch->PUT (preserves all logged sets/reps/weights) and (b) create the Increase Repetitions rep-ladder via POST. Principled rest scheme: compound near-max (1-2 RIR) ~120s, accessory ~90s, isolation/core/rehab 45-60s. Full Body / Cuff / Abs were already sensible and are intentionally NOT touched.

new_routines.title: 🟩 Increase Repetitions (Comeback)
new_routines.notes: Rep-Ladder (Donnerstag, Phase 1). Auf-/absteigende Leiter pro Übung, RIR 1-2, NICHT bis Versagen. Ziel: über die Wochen die Leiter verlängern / mehr Wdh. pro Stufe. Kurze Pausen zwischen den Stufen.
